sources.title: Why customers switch
sources.content:
# Why customers switch
Our customers most often move away from a manual WordPress workflow, because editorial approvals take 2–3 hours every week. Agencies cite missed publishing slots as the second reason.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.content:
# Topiqu pricing
The Pro plan costs 49 USD per month and includes scheduled AI articles, translations into one extra language and the media library. Premium costs 99 USD and adds Search Console autopilot.

sources.title: Positioning vs Jasper
sources.content:
# Topiqu compared with Jasper
Jasper is a general AI writing assistant. Topiqu runs the whole publication: it researches, writes, reviews facts, publishes on a schedule and hosts the blog. Approved claim: Topiqu verifies every article against live web sources before publishing.

sources.title: Case study Pixbo
sources.content:
# Pixbo case study
Pixbo, a gaming news site, grew organic traffic by 180 % in six months after switching to scheduled Topiqu articles with official game screenshots from Steam.

sources.title: Překlady
sources.content:
# Automatické překlady
Topiqu překládá publikované články do dalších jazyků. Režim HYBRID nechá překlad čekat na schválení redaktorem, režim AUTO ho publikuje hned a správně nastaví hreflang.

sources.title: Security
sources.content:
# Security and data
Customer data is stored in the EU. Tenant isolation is enforced by row-level access policies, and every article change is written to a tamper-evident audit log.

sources.title: Office rules
sources.content:
# Office rules
Dogs are welcome in the Prague office on Fridays. Parking is available in the courtyard; please register your car at reception.

sources.title: Holiday policy
sources.content:
# Holiday policy
Employees get 25 days of paid leave. Requests go through the HR portal at least two weeks in advance.

sources.title: Legacy plan codes
sources.content:
# Legacy plan codes
The legacy plan GRWPLS was retired in March 2026. Customers on GRWPLS moved to Premium at their old price until the end of their billing year.

sources.title: Rechnungsstellung
sources.content:
# Rechnungsstellung
Rechnungen werden monatlich per SEPA-Lastschrift eingezogen. Die Rechnungsadresse mit Straße, Postleitzahl und Ort lässt sich jederzeit im Konto ändern.

sources.title: Wsparcie
sources.content:
# Wsparcie klienta
Zespół wsparcia Topiqu odpowiada w ciągu 4 godzin w dni robocze, także na czacie po polsku. Zgłoszenie złożysz przyciskiem „Pomoc” w panelu.
